name: GANCUBE Puzzles in Pi Day Pampanga 2026
information:
Puzzles in Pi Day Pampanga 2026 marks a special, one-of-a-kind speedcubing competition held in celebration of Pi Day on March 14, 2026, organized by the Cabalen Cubers Club.

This WCA-sanctioned event brings together speedcubers from across the country for a unique fusion of logic, mathematics, and competitive cubing. Set in the heart of Pampanga, the competition celebrates precision, creativity, and the passion that unites the local and national cubing community.

The competition is officially sponsored and held in partnership with GANCUBE, one of the leading brands in speedcubing innovation, whose support helps elevate the overall competition experience for all participants.
